player_prompt.intro:
I Slitherlink {R}x{C} grid-ah khelh dawn i ni!
Loop khat chauh siam tur a ni, numbered cell tinrengin a border edge zawng zawng a nei thei ang.
Edge-te chu hetiang hian toggle rawh:
  [h r c] - row r, column c a dots chungnungah horizontal edge toggle rawh
  [v r c] - row r, column c a dots veilamah vertical edge toggle rawh
Number-te chuan edge zawng zawng a neih ngaihna a entir, '.' chuan harsatna a awm lo tih a entir.
{max_turns} move thleng i nei a, puzzle chhuang tur a ni.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action format a dik lo. [h row col] emaw [v row col] hman rawh.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: A pâwn lam chu a dang ta mai.

outcome.win: 🎉 I loop khat chauh i siam! Puzzle chinfel ta!
outcome.turn_limit: Hnawh chin chu a thleng ta. Puzzle zawh lohva awm.
